data.body: **[P2] Publish revocation before exposing the missing token.** `checkpointToken` becomes null before `handleMissingToken()` sets `checkpointTokenRevoked`. A queued default-semantics step can start in that interval, pass the new worker guard, ignore its immediately failed asynchronous START checkpoint, and execute user side effects. Its result cannot be checkpointed, so replay repeats that work. Read the response token into a local and publish nonterminal revocation before assigning null. Add a worker-admission race test; the poller-completion test covers only the later publication boundary.
